title: LEGO × Pokémon GO Cap Timed Research
description: Redeem this promo code for Bonus Timed Research that awards berries, XP, Stardust, and the 2026 LEGO® Pokémon Cap. The Cap Timed Research is unavailable in Japan, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia, where LEGO® Pokémon™ products are not sold. Trainers in these regions can still redeem the code for alternate Timed Research with different rewards, including a Lucky Egg. Tasks must be completed and rewards claimed before Wednesday, September 30, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. local time. Research details[here](https://leekduck.com/events/lego-pokemon-go-2026/).

title: MLB-branded T-shirt Avatar Item
description: To celebrate the Pokémon GO and Major League Baseball collaboration returning for the 2026 season, trainers can redeem this code to get an exclusive MLB-branded T-shirt avatar item. Offer code available for redemption until September 30, 2026. Learn more[here](https://pokemongo.com/post/mlb-2026).

title: LEGO × Pokémon GO Berries
description: Promo code for free berries and Poké Balls tied to the Pokémon GO and LEGO Group partnership. Learn more[here](https://leekduck.com/events/lego-pokemon-go-2026/).

title: FENDI x FRGMT x POKÉMON Hoodie Avatar Item
description: Trainers can redeem this code to get an exclusive FENDI x FRGMT x POKÉMON hoodie avatar item. (This code should have expired on January 4, 2025 but it appears to still work.)
